records.section_heading: OPEN A new record for a massive Porites colony at Ta'u Island, American Samoa
records.question: What were the measurements (height, circumference, and diameter) of the largest Porites colony measured in November 2019 at Ta'u, American Samoa?
records.ground_truth_answer: It measured 8 m tall, 69 m in circumference, and had a diameter of 22.4 m.
ground_truth_chunks: This coral was measured in November 2019 as part of an effort to catalogue all large (≥ 2 m diameter) Porites colonies around Ta'u.
The largest colony measured 8 m tall, 69 m in circumference and had a diameter of 22.4 m.

records.question: On which dates were the tow-board surveys around Ta'u conducted?
ground_truth_chunks: From November 25–27, 2019 tow-board surveys were conducted on the northern, eastern, and western sides of Ta'u (Fig. 2).
SCUBA dives were conducted on November 26 and 27, 2019, to document fve of the newly catalogued corals recorded during the surveys.

records.question: How many individual colonies exceeding 10 m in diameter (scale 3) were identified during the tow-board surveys?
ground_truth_chunks: Tow-board surveys covered a distance of 21.5 km and the efort identifed 84 individual colonies exceeding 10 m in diameter (scale 3; Fig. 2), 393 colonies between 6–10 m (scale 2) and 498 colonies between 2–5 m (scale 1).
